question_text: At $800^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$, iron oxidizes at a rate of $0.014 \mathrm{~g} / \mathrm{cm}^2$ per hour; at $1000^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$, iron oxidizes at a rate of $0.0656 \mathrm{~g} / \mathrm{cm}^2$ per hour. Assuming a parabolic oxidation rate, determine the maximum temperature at which iron can be held if the oxidation rate is to be less than $0.005 \mathrm{~g} / \mathrm{cm}^2$ per hour.The unit of the answer is °C.
